project.name: ATLAS Isseksi Copper Project
project.strategicTitle: A Licensed Copper Asset with a Preliminary Mine Construction & Processing Orientation Study
project.positioning: ATLAS Isseksi Copper Project is a licensed copper asset supported by field evidence, laboratory assays, and a preliminary mine construction and processing orientation study, with a digital validation pathway designed to convert the opportunity into a structured operating platform.
project.keyMessage: Atlas Mining controls a licensed copper asset with preliminary field, laboratory, and engineering evidence, now structured for intelligent validation and operating entry.

layers.title: Atlas License Position
layers.summary: Exploitation License No. 353294 over 15.36 km², valid 2024–2034, with environmental approval CRI/24/102 — the legal foundation Atlas Mining controls.

layers.title: Field & Laboratory Evidence
layers.summary: May 2025 field visit, ≈232 m trenching, 29 AFRILAB samples and selected copper assays up to 9.65% Cu — selected-sample evidence, not average grade.

layers.title: Orientation Study Asset
layers.summary: A.I.P.S preliminary orientation study: 2.3 Mt @ 1.8% Cu, 800 t/day plant, 124.4M MAD HT CAPEX — a base case to be upgraded, not a feasibility study.

layers.title: Intelligent Validation System
layers.summary: The ATLAS Intelligent Copper Targeting System — an independent decision-support layer that reduces blind exploration and supports pilot-feed definition.

layers.title: 180-Day Feasibility Upgrade
layers.summary: A six-phase, 180-day roadmap converting documents and assumptions into a structured commercial decision.

layers.title: Structured Operating Entry
layers.summary: USD 150,000 Non-Refundable Entry & Validation Access fee — structured access to validation and operating negotiation, not a license sale.
